description: This file defines classes, enums, and interfaces related to fault injection mechanisms within the Orleans transaction testing framework, including control structures for transaction fault injection phases and types, as well as transactional state management with fault injection capabilities.

classes.name: FaultInjectionControl
classes.description: Holds fault injection phase and type configurations for transaction fault injection control.

classes.name: TransactionFaultInjectPhase
classes.description: Enumeration of different phases during which fault injection can occur in a transaction.

classes.name: FaultInjectionType
classes.description: Enumeration of the types of fault injections applicable to transactions.

classes.name: IFaultInjectionTransactionalState`1
classes.description: Interface extending ITransactionalState to include fault injection control, parameterized by transaction state type.

classes.name: FaultInjectionTransactionalState`1
classes.description: Implementation of fault injection transactional state, managing fault injection control, resource registration, and lifecycle participation.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the fault injection control to default 'None' states.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the transactional state to lifecycle events for setup.

methods.name: SetupResourceFactory
methods.description: Configures resource factories for fault injection in transactional resources and transaction managers.

methods.name: PerformRead
methods.description: Performs a read operation within the transactional state context, with fault injection considerations.

methods.name: PerformUpdate
methods.description: Performs an update operation within the transactional state context, with fault injection considerations.
